result: Lean module LqgEprlVertexImport compiles under Lean 4.35.0. It imports no Mathlib module. The lakefile still pins Mathlib commit 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679. Five declarations use only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The five-index pair count uses no axioms. These declarations are rational label arithmetic. They do not construct an EPRL-FK vertex, a 15j symbol, a booster, or a continuum, semiclassical, or cosmological-constant limit. The node stays IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION.
proof_boundary: For rational gamma and rational k, j+ = |1 + gamma| k / 2 and j- = |1 - gamma| k / 2. When 0 < gamma < 1 the sum is k and the difference is gamma k. When gamma > 1 the difference is k and the sum is gamma k. The recorded points are gamma = 1/2, k = 2; gamma = 3, k = 2; and gamma = 1, k = 2. The Lorentzian pair is (n, rho) = (2 k, 2 gamma k), and at gamma = 1/2, k = 2 it is (4, 2). Five indices determine 10 unordered pairs. A Spin(4) 15j contraction, boosters, continuum representations, spin sums, and every limit stay outside this module.
